name: Sarakedase! Yagai Roshutsu Haishin
original_name: さらけだせ！ 野外露出配信
source: Stream by day, prank by night, and build your fame in this RPG adventure game! As IRL streamer Laika, create content, earn subscribers, and expand your skills. Explore the city and risk it all to entertain your growing audience. Show them what they actually want to see...
translation: 白天直播，夜晚恶作剧，在这款RPG冒险游戏中一路打响你的知名度吧！你将扮演户外真人主播莱卡，创作直播内容、收获订阅粉丝并不断拓展自身技能。探索整座城市，不惜赌上一切去取悦日益壮大的观众群体——向他们展示他们真正想看的画面吧……
